items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: I saw one picture from a poster, it wasn't very clear, that Lawrence Dewey, the clarinetist had.

ctx.x: And they had William Williams, he was a piano player at that time in some of the old, and he was a drummer, Dennis Adam, he was a drummer and his brother Bird called Adam. And who else it was? At that time William was playing piano before Gus Vaughn and his daughter started playing after that because William died. And I see who else, I can't remember. See, sometimes I have to see those people. I'm the same right now. Can't think of the names of the band. Because that's the story, I ain't good on, I can't…

I saw one picture from a poster, it wasn't very clear, that Lawrence Dewey, the clarinetist had. The Banner Band? With Bunk and it also had Yvonne Thomas in it. Yeah. They called it the, does Yvonne play there too?
Yeah, he used to play in it, uh-huh. He used to play in it, uh-huh. In the dinner too. Well, see they used to go and come, you know. Yeah, he used to play in it.
